newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Quantum raises A$18 mln in placement.
newsitem.headline: Quantum raises A$18 mln in placement.

text.p: Gold explorer Quantum Resources NL said on Thursday it would raise A$18 million through a placement to international fund manager of 4.5 million shares at a price of A$4.00 per share.

Quantum said the placement had been jointly arranged by Bell Securities Ltd and Prudential-Bache Securities (Australia) Ltd, which will be paid a commission of four percent on total funds raised via the placement.
It said the funds raised would be used for the company's mineral exploration activities and working capital requirements.

Quantum forms part of the mining entrepreneur Joseph Gutnick stable of companies, led by Great Central Mines NL, and has plans to expand into China and other parts of Asia with the help of former Australian Prime Minister Bob Hawke, who is now a business consultant.
At 12.15 p.m. (0115 GMT), Quantum shares were 30 cents or 6.67 percent up at A$4.80.
